scripts.start:dev: set -a; source .env.dev; set +a; lsof -ti:${PORT:-3000} | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; node -r dotenv/config node_modules/@nestjs/cli/bin/nest.js start --watch dotenv_config_path=.env.dev
scripts.start:prod: set -a; source .env.prod; set +a; lsof -ti:${PORT:-3000} | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; node -r dotenv/config dist/main dotenv_config_path=.env.prod
scripts.prisma:migrate: set -a; source .env.dev; set +a; prisma migrate dev
scripts.prisma:migrate:prod: set -a; source .env.prod; set +a; prisma migrate deploy
scripts.prisma:reset: set -a; source .env.dev; set +a; prisma migrate reset --force
scripts.client:dev: set -a; source .env.dev; set +a; lsof -ti:${CLIENT_PORT:-5173} | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; cd client && CLIENT_PORT=$CLIENT_PORT PORT=$PORT yarn dev
scripts.backtest: set -a; source .env.dev; set +a; ts-node -r dotenv/config src/backtest/runner/backtest-cli.ts dotenv_config_path=.env.dev
scripts.backtest:prod: set -a; source .env.prod; set +a; ts-node -r dotenv/config src/backtest/runner/backtest-cli.ts dotenv_config_path=.env.prod
